post.caption:
Echolocation: emit a call, time the return, build a spatial picture. Some bats can judge texture and speed, not just distance. The best part is the arms race — some moths jam bat sonar with ultrasonic clicks, and others evolved sound-absorbing scales that make them acoustically invisible.
